title: Hierarchy Organization
description: Create a structured scene with parent‑child relationships, locking, and visibility toggles.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Practice organizing GameObjects.

1. In a new empty scene (or your HelloUnity scene), create the following objects:
   - An empty GameObject named "Environment".
   - Under it, a Cube named "Floor" (reset its position).
   - Under it, a Sphere named "Ball".
2. Parent the Cube and Sphere under "Environment" by dragging them onto it in the Hierarchy.
3. Lock the "Floor" object so you cannot select it in the Scene view.
4. Toggle the visibility (eye icon) of the "Ball" off, then back on.
5. Select all three objects at once using Ctrl+Click. Verify they appear in the Inspector together.
6. Rename the "Ball" to "Orb" using F2.

Take a screenshot of the final Hierarchy showing the parent‑child structure, the lock icon on Floor, and the visibility icons.
hints: An empty GameObject is created via GameObject > Create Empty.
Lock and visibility toggles appear on the right side of the Hierarchy when hovering over the object.
expectedOutput:
A screenshot of the Hierarchy window showing:
- "Environment" parent with children "Floor" and "Orb".
- The lock icon activated on Floor.
- Both children visible (eye icon enabled).
